body:
This PR adds two independent Lean packages. The Hug package checks energy accounts from the earlier **threshold-0.015 experiment**. The other package checks a separate two-memory mathematical example. The later **threshold-1 closest-point experiment** has its own numerical records and is outside the proofs in this PR.

## What the Hug package checks

The Hug simulation recorded work, heat and changes in stored fabric energy in three- and four-write runs. Its force threshold was **0.015**. The two breathing histories were always off and on until prime 41.

Nine named Lean statements check the exact recorded arithmetic and displayed rounding. They cover 82 meter rows, the fourth-write account at prime 59, and the change in signed energy residual at prime 157. The input check also reproduces the Lean numeric data from the two receipts and CSV. [Threshold recorded in the inputs](https://github.com/NousVolition/hug-sims-lean-proofs/blob/18c921c3d2acd3b1ded0398d53087ad1b3e69b68/lean/hug-prime-meter-lean/evidence/off.json) · [Package scope](https://github.com/NousVolition/hug-sims-lean-proofs/blob/18c921c3d2acd3b1ded0398d53087ad1b3e69b68/lean/hug-prime-meter-lean/README.md)

A pass establishes that those finite energy accounts follow the stated arithmetic rules for the supplied measurements. The simulated trajectories remain measured inputs. The checks do not certify a continuum fluid solution or establish that every model choice represents the intended Hug.

## What the two-memory package checks

This is a separate mathematical example of how the odds of two memory weights change along a cue route. Its original ten transport statements include composition, exact return around a closed cue route, and field identities for the specified constant abelian potential. Six supporting Volterra lemmas are also checked, with assumptions removed where their proofs do not need them.

`TwoMemoryTransport.lean` and `TwoMemory.lean` preserve the original source bytes. The field statements apply to this defined potential on four Euclidean coordinates. They make no claim about the threshold-1 water-particle switches. [Original transport scope](https://github.com/NousVolition/hug-sims-lean-proofs/blob/18c921c3d2acd3b1ded0398d53087ad1b3e69b68/lean/original-two-memory-transport-lean/README.md)

## How the threshold-1 result differs

The later rerun changes the force threshold from 0.015 to **1 from the original time-zero state**, keeping the same water particle A and original partner B. With breathing on throughout, three late closest-point exchanges occur near **1.180910, 1.182077 and 1.199281**, before prime 41 at time 1.2. The earlier event near 1.178285 does not recur there.

That result has its own [published numerical record and configuration](https://github.com/NousVolition/hug-sims-lean-proofs/blob/90d0cc5d9bc27276405cbcad717bb6dcf0c5f58c/research/hug-v3/threshold-one-follow-up/README.md). **No Lean proof in this PR checks that trajectory or those exchanges.** Local time refinement resolves the recorded events on the fixed grid and inherited integration history. Spatial and full-history convergence remain open. The matched threshold-1 breathing-off control is complete: it resolves five earlier exchange examples and finds none in the two matched late windows containing the three on examples. Breathing changes the measured history and is not necessary for every exchange. These are examples, not exhaustive counts; 24 rapid route changes remain unresolved. [Completed control and saved evidence](https://github.com/NousVolition/hug-sims-lean-proofs/blob/main/research/review-updates/2026-11-11/README.md#breathing-changes-the-observed-switches)

The threshold-0.015 measurements and threshold-1 observations remain separate experiments. The newer run does not replace the earlier energy inputs or receive their Lean verification status.

The threshold-1 measurement also leaves a question about the viewing window. Its finite line segment starts at A, and the third late exchange involves that endpoint. The open interpretation is that an edge in the view may be mistaken for an edge in the connection before the whole path has been followed. Extending the trace in both directions is a way to investigate this. The present records do not establish a closed circulation loop or that a viewing boundary caused the exchanges. [Connection beyond the visible trace](https://github.com/NousVolition/hug-sims-lean-proofs/blob/90d0cc5d9bc27276405cbcad717bb6dcf0c5f58c/research/hug-v3/threshold-one-follow-up/README.md#connection-beyond-the-visible-trace)

## Verification evidence for this PR

Both packages have pinned dependencies, their own default build targets, and separate references for the verification workflow. Local validation used Lean 4.34.0-rc2 and the pinned Mathlib revision, including both solution and reference builds, all 25 theorem axiom reports, input regeneration and hashes, repository package checks, the 13 repository tests, and the public-path check. No unused-assumption warnings remain in the solution builds.

GitHub verified commit `18c921c3d2acd3b1ded0398d53087ad1b3e69b68`. The frozen-statement comparison, Lean's kernel, nanoda, Linux builds and axiom audits passed for both packages. The Hug input-reproduction workflow also passed. [Lean verification run](https://github.com/NousVolition/hug-sims-lean-proofs/actions/runs/42852357760) · [Hug input check](https://github.com/NousVolition/hug-sims-lean-proofs/actions/runs/42852357860)

The passing reports are attached as [Hug proof evidence](https://github.com/NousVolition/hug-sims-lean-proofs/actions/runs/42852357760/artifacts/13781586964) and [original transport proof evidence](https://github.com/NousVolition/hug-sims-lean-proofs/actions/runs/42852357760/artifacts/13781093147). Both packages now contain the actual passing `verification-report.json`, all six unmodified artifact files under `evidence-linux/`, and a source record linking the artifact digest, tested merge `173b4c609838c447b92ae4e9cd6fc9549b3d9026`, PR head and unchanged proof-input hashes. The newer package-index entries from main are preserved. Publishing the evidence and clarifying the documentation adds no new Lean result.


The updated PR head `a00ae2324e97cd92b6dea492276f551df60ec8e1` also passed the fresh [Lean verification run](https://github.com/NousVolition/hug-sims-lean-proofs/actions/runs/42986471234) for both packages and the [Hug input reproduction check](https://github.com/NousVolition/hug-sims-lean-proofs/actions/runs/42986471278). The checked-in historical artifacts remain tied to their original run and unchanged proof inputs.
